turns.text: Thanks for calling Copper Wok Eastside, how can I help?
Hi, can I get a delivery? I'd like the scallion pancakes and the mapo tofu and the kung pao chicken.
Also, my husband has a shellfish allergy.
Of course. So we're checking for shellfish, for your husband, right?
I checked our allergen list: the scallion pancakes has no shellfish listed, though it's prepared in a shared kitchen, so cross-contact is possible.
Sure. What's the full delivery address?

Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
